WaitNode_Use_Desc1: • Fixed time: Synchronous blocking, suitable for scenarios where the waiting duration needs to be determined.
WaitNode_Use_Desc2: • Condition waiting: Continuously checks until the condition is met. Supports synchronous/asynchronous operation.
WaitNode_Use_Desc3: • Warning mode: When the conditions are met, an orange warning pop-up box will appear and requires manual confirmation.
WaitNode_Use_Desc5: • Right-side value examples: 100, true, completed status.

Infinite timeout (continuously waiting
until the condition is met)
WaitNode_Warning: When the opening conditions are met, an orange warning pop-up box will appear. It requires manual confirmation before proceeding
WaitNode_WaitFor:
Start timing only after the equipment is
stable.
WaitNode_WaitForSub: After being selected, the node will first wait for the selected device to enter a stable state, and then start the countdown.
WaitNode_StabTip: If the process is not fully stable by this time, an error will be reported.
WAitNode_StabWaitNode:
Stay time waiting node (DOE steady - 
state insulation)
WaitNode_StabNodeTip: After checking, Xiaotong's「Dynamic Waiting Based on Stay Time」only drives this node: Each set of experiments automatically overrides the waiting duration based on the stay time, and resets at the end of the batch. Only one process can be checked at a time.

Parallel_Instruction_Desc1: • No waiting: Start all branches immediately and continue without delay. The branches will run in the background.
